general_news.title: GM makes $4.5 billion deal with parts company
general_news.summary: General Motors has entered into a $4.5 billion agreement with Procura Auto Parts to secure critical inventory and mitigate future supply chain disruptions. This deal aims to prevent shortages similar to those experienced in recent years, including the chip shortage. Procura will facilitate advance funding to GM suppliers, who will then hold inventory on GM's behalf.
